ValidationRule.description: 若 Agent Category 為 Account Visit，請填寫 Account 並清空 Account Code； 若為 Prospecting Visit，請填寫 Account Code 並清空 Account。
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Agent Category is "Account Visit", please enter Account and leave Account Code blank. If Agent Category is "Prospecting Visit", please enter Account Code and leave Account blank. Both fields cannot be left blank.
